heading.text: Your sessions: each one is its own mine and its own save.
Delete Session 1? Its mine, money, upgrades, rebirths and drills are gone for good.
Delete Session 2? Its mine, money, upgrades, rebirths and drills are gone for good.
Tap a drill to buy it.
Rebirth? Money, upgrades and drills of this session reset. You keep a permanent income bonus.
